result.summary: The image shows a high-density urban intersection with wide sidewalks and a prominent textured brick crosswalk. While pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the wide brick-textured crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflict
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for vehicle turns across the pedestrian path of travel.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area where cars are positioned to turn or travel through.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or obstructions near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban commercial environment with wide, well-maintained sidewalks and signalized traffic control. However, the immediate foreground intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which reduces the clarity of pedestrian right-of-way.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection reduces pedestrian visibility and predictability for turning motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.
